_comment: Pattern → skill name(s) lookup for the skill-router hook. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regexes against the user prompt text. Multiple matches yield a deduplicated suggestion list. Only suggestions, not auto-invocations.

rules.pattern: (?i)\b(retro|postmortem|post mortem|lesson|learning|consolidate|curate|institutional memory|what did we learn|review the log)\b
(?i)\b(first[- ]?principles|beast[- ]?mode|design phase|track a|track b|realist|critic|domain expert room|adr|architecture decision)\b
(?i)\b(ef core|dbcontext|migration|TUnit|aspire|opentelemetry|otel|smart constructor|state machine|sum type|result<|option<|capability function|functional ddd|aclair|bounded context|domain event)\b
(?i)\b(wcag|aa compliance|aria|keyboard nav|tab order|screen reader|color contrast|cognitive load|hick's law|fitts|jakob|design system|tailwind|spacing scale|component variant)\b
(?i)\b(web component|service worker|web worker|shadow dom|import map|es2024|navigation api|mutation observer|broadcastchannel|tagged template|waapi|fetch \+ abortcontroller)\b
(?i)\b(code review|reviewer|review the diff|review pr|missing review lockout|merge gate|review verdict|approve this pr)\b
(?i)\b(gh\b|gh cli|github cli|gh pr|gh run|gh release|gh issue|gh api|gh workflow|gh auth)\b
(?i)\b(az\b|az cli|azure cli|az login|az account|az group|az containerapp|az webapp|az keyvault|az postgres|az monitor)\b

(?i)\b(dotnet build|dotnet test|dotnet run|dotnet ef|dotnet format|dotnet pack|dotnet publish|dotnet watch|dotnet add package|dotnet new|dotnet list package|directory.build.props|directory.packages.props)\b
(?i)\b(playwright|playwright codegen|playwright trace|page object|e2e test|browser test|trace.zip|playwright install)\b
(?i)\b(git worktree|git bisect|git range-diff|git rebase|git reflog|git stash|autosquash|fixup commit|sparse[- ]checkout|partial clone|signed commit|--force-with-lease)\b
